decisions.notes: TASK-SPECIFIC CHECK: confirmed this 2026 row is a genuinely separate instrument from ga-coweta-county-2025. The 2025 row (date_enacted_iso 2025-05-06, enacted_status 'replaced') was the original 180-day moratorium that led to the county's permanent data-center ordinance, adopted Dec. 16, 2025 -- which is itself now under litigation over the 'Project Sail' rezoning it approved. This 2026 row (date_enacted_iso 2026-06-16) is a second, later 180-day moratorium adopted specifically to REVIEW that same December 2025 ordinance, and explicitly exempts the five already-vested projects (including Project Sail) grandfathered under it. Different trigger, different purpose (review of an existing ordinance vs. original regulatory gap), 13 months apart -- not a duplicate.
